events.title: Frank Rosenblatt builds the Perceptron
events.summary: Frank Rosenblatt built the Perceptron in 1957 — an early trainable neural network that launched the first wave of connectionist AI.
events.about: The Perceptron could learn linearly separable patterns from examples — inspiring decades of neural network research and the famous Minsky–Papert critique that sparked AI winters and revivals.

narrative.whyChosen: The Perceptron was the first hardware neural learning machine.
narrative.whyImportant: It introduced trainable weights as an approach to pattern recognition.
narrative.problemSolved: Pattern recognition required hand-coded rules instead of learning from data.
